rules.rationale: Defines the even-remainder case of the named one-step Collatz summary collatzNext.
Defines the odd-remainder case of the named one-step Collatz summary collatzNext.
Defines validCollatzTrace on the empty structural base case.
Defines validCollatzTrace on a singleton integer trace.
Defines the structural recurrence for validating adjacent Collatz trace elements.
Completes the validCollatzTrace definition for sequence shapes not handled by its integer cases.
Defines traceFirstInt for a sequence whose first value is an integer.
Provides the default case completing the traceFirstInt summary definition.
Defines traceLastInt on the empty sequence.
Defines traceLastInt on a singleton integer sequence.
Defines the structural tail recurrence used to find the last trace value.
Completes traceLastInt with its default sequence-shape case.
Defines maybeOdd for an even integer as the empty value sequence.
Defines maybeOdd for an odd integer as a singleton value sequence.
Defines oddWithoutLast on the empty structural base case.
Defines oddWithoutLast on a singleton by excluding its final element.
Defines the even-head recurrence of the oddWithoutLast sequence filter.
Defines the odd-head recurrence of the oddWithoutLast sequence filter.
Completes oddWithoutLast for non-integer head values while structurally descending.
Adds right identity for the pre-existing valSeqConcat function; Stage 1 loads this simplification before proving the target and contains no separate proof of this exact rule.
Adds associativity for the pre-existing valSeqConcat function; it is present in the compiled target theory rather than first proved in a rule-free module.
Adds a nonemptiness fact for concatenation with a nonempty right operand, with no prior exact Stage 1 proof independent of the rule.
Adds the symmetric nonemptiness fact for concatenation, and Stage 1 provides no separate proof before this simplification is loaded.
States how traceFirstInt observes a one-element append to a nonempty sequence; it is an additional append law used directly by the target proof.
States how traceLastInt observes a one-element append; no Stage 1 command first proves the exact statement without this rule.
Relates validCollatzTrace of an appended sequence to the prior trace and final transition; it is trusted in the same module used to close the proof.
Relates oddWithoutLast over an appended valid trace to the prior filter and former last value; Stage 1 does not separately prove it before use.
